# Bundled LDAC libraries

- `encoder` contains the Sony LDAC encoder from Android Open Source Project revision `eeee1a3f5f8df1282e3a6d297085885fd886737b`. Its Apache 2.0 license and notice are included. The Windows build removes an unused POSIX header and makes the unused-parameter annotation portable. [Upstream source](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/libldac/+/eeee1a3f5f8df1282e3a6d297085885fd886737b)
- `decoder` contains the MIT-licensed libldacdec library from revision `7f3bd6cc1586b764b02f2e4f20b16c7ff18758b9`. The integration builds without the upstream command-line tools. Local changes provide portable C functions, C++ linkage, separate initialization for shared tables, and floating-point PCM output. The decoder processes streams generated by the bundled encoder. [Upstream source](https://github.com/hegdi/libldacdec/tree/7f3bd6cc1586b764b02f2e4f20b16c7ff18758b9)
